metaTitle: The Event | Valdivia Bike Fest - international UCI MTB race
metaDescription: Learn about Valdivia Bike Fest: an international UCI mountain bike race in Valdivia, Chile. Identity, purpose, community, and a story that grows every year.

hero.intro: More than a competition: a meeting point between continental mountain biking and the cycling community of southern Chile.
hero.bgAlt: Natural landscape of southern Chile, forests and rivers of Valdivia

queEs.leadHtml: Valdivia Bike Fest is an international mountain bike competition held in Valdivia, Los Ríos Region, Chile. Organized as a round of the American Continental Series MTB, the event brings together top cross-country riders from the continent and offers a world-class competitive experience in one of the most distinctive natural settings in southern Chile.

items.title: UCI Calendar
items.text: A round of the American Continental Series MTB with points toward the world ranking.

items.title: Two formats
items.text: Cross-Country Olympic (XCO) and Short Track (XCC) at a single venue.

items.title: National selection
items.text: First selection round for the Chilean National Team.

items.title: Develop mountain biking in Chile
items.text: Create international-level competitions that place the country on the continental calendar and give Chilean athletes the chance to earn UCI points without leaving home.

items.title: Opportunities for riders of all levels
items.text: From Elite and Sub23 categories to Master, youth, and promotional. The event opens the door to established riders and those just starting their competitive journey.

items.title: Competition and community in one place
items.text: Combining high performance with a family-friendly, inclusive atmosphere where every participant — regardless of level — is a key part of the event.

items.title: Position Valdivia as a sports destination
items.text: Let international riders discover southern Chile: its forests, rivers, and the culture of a city best explored without rushing.

internacional.leadHtml: Valdivia Bike Fest is part of the American Continental Series MTB calendar, which means each edition attracts top cross-country riders from South America and across the Pan-American region, including continental champions, Olympic medalists, and national teams from across the continent.

comunidad.copy: Valdivia Bike Fest is not just for elite athletes. It is a family-friendly, inclusive event where the community of riders, families, and mountain bike fans comes together around competition and nature.

features.title: Open categories
features.text: Short Track Open and Promotional for those who want the race experience without a UCI license.

features.title: Youth and cadets
features.text: Categories from pre-youth to youth, so the next generation can grow in the sport.

features.title: Master A, B, C and D
features.text: From 30 to 60 and beyond. Competition has no age limit.
